body:
My friend and had the day off of school, he suggested to huff some ether. We were out of grass and bored so I was like fuck it lets go. Never again, after enough pulls of this shit you start to lose your mind. At least I did, eventually I was convinced that he was satan himself and demanded that he open the ground up to show me. Ya it was fucked up because it was a stump from an old cut down tree. I thought it was a hole into the underworld it freaked me out. But after I cand back to earth I realized how fucked up this was and then was convinced to stick to grass.
